en: Fixed auto mode failing every turn outside Claude Desktop with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` set behind a gateway rejecting betas, on Bedrock, Agent Platform, Foundry or Claude apps gateway
zh: 修复了在 Claude Desktop 之外、通过网关设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` 且网关拒绝 beta 功能时，以及在 Bedrock、Agent Platform、Foundry 或 Claude 应用网关上，自动模式每轮都失败的问题
